name: pi-code-hygiene
description: Run codehygiene on every file Pi writes or edits and report readability problems that linters miss.
author: Yivas (https://github.com/Yivas)

scripts.check: node --check src/index.js && node --check src/config.js && node --check src/command.js && node --check src/menu.js && node --check src/lines.js && node --check src/fix.js && node --check test/helpers.js && node --check test/index.test.js && node --check test/config.test.js && node --check test/command.test.js && node --check test/menu.test.js && node --check test/fix.test.js && node --check test/lines.test.js && node --check test/upstream-watch.test.js
